faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does a corporate site take?
delivery.answer: Typically 3-6 weeks depending on scope. We provide a custom timeline after the discovery call.

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: Based on scope, number of pages and integration requirements. We provide a clear proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: How many revisions do I get?
revisions.answer: Unlimited revisions during the design phase. Changes during development are handled within the agreed scope.

maintenance.question: Is there post-launch support?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We offer 3 months of free technical support after launch, followed by optional monthly maintenance packages.

migration.question: Can you migrate our existing site?
migration.answer: Yes. We migrate your existing content, images and SEO value to the new site without any loss.

mobile.question: Will it be mobile-friendly?
mobile.answer: Absolutely. All our sites are built with a mobile-first approach and work flawlessly on every device.
